archetype: hardened two-hall data campus with security, network operations, power, cooling and loading
operational_workflow: public vestibule and guarded security screening
reception, visitor control, staff lockers and administration
two separately fire-zoned server halls and controlled service spine
network-entry/meet-me room and protected media vault
receiving, spares, maintenance and fire-suppression control
cooling-water and air-handling plant with independent utility access
damage_constraints: localize the impact to the southeast server-hall/power boundary and adjacent yard
use a jagged tapered blast bowl and gravity-led debris rather than a cylindrical void
preserve public security, network operations, west server hall and western loading route
preserve the complete upper administration floor and its stair
derive all damage and occupation from the immutable clean master

required_manual_checks: security, server, utility and loading masses read as distinct operational volumes
server-rack aisles and hardened thresholds have player-scale clearance
public, utility and loading traffic remain visibly separated
the southeast impact reads as an external bomb strike rather than an arbitrary hole
surviving routes remain dangerous but usable
terrain feathering seats the impact bowl and service courts into surrounding terrain
